lines.text: We’ve walked through fire and we’ve walked through rain
We’ve held each other when the words were hard to say
I don’t need perfect, I just need you here
Honest and steady, year after year
The light is fading but my promise is bright
Written in the quiet of this golden light
Golden, you make everything feel right
Even in the dark you’re my favorite kind of light
I’ll hold you close when the world feels wide
Golden — forever by your side
We’ve seen the best and we’ve seen the worst
Still choosing this love when it’s hard at first
No need for perfect, just honest and true
This life we’re building is strong enough for two
The light is fading but my promise is bright
Written in the quiet of this golden light
Golden, you make everything feel right
Even in the dark you’re my favorite kind of light
I’ll hold you close when the world feels wide
Golden — forever by your side
Even when the stars go quiet, my love will light the way
This is our story and it’s only just begun today
Golden, you make everything feel right
Even in the dark you’re my favorite kind of light
I’ll hold you close when the world feels wide
Golden — forever by your side
